title: Invoice
description: A billing invoice for an organization.

id.description: The unique identifier of the invoice.

period_start.description: The start date of the billing period.

period_end.description: The end date of the billing period.

total.description: The total invoice amount in cents.

currency.description: The currency code for the invoice.

status.description: The payment status of the invoice.

created_at.description: The timestamp when the invoice was generated.
